name: DAW Control
description: DAW controller surface: pads play the DAW, the DAW lights the pads and fills the screen (FL Studio, Ableton Live, REAPER)
changelog: 0.5.0: Ableton Live MIDI Remote Script (host/ableton/CrossPad/, Live 11+): pads play the selected track, armed implicitly, Drum Rack pad colours, track/clip/tempo rows, transport and beat; control layout with transport, track select, metronome tempo, undo and eight meter-lit mutes; the encoder selects tracks
0.4.3: registry description and README name the DAWs with a host script today (FL Studio, REAPER); Ableton Live is coming, not ready

0.4.2: the host status comes from crosspad-gui (platformStatus()) instead of a global every platform had to define; the double-tap toggle reaches LVGL through postToGui(); a root deleted before the app's teardown is handled (gui 2.0 calls destroy with none); builds on core 1.70+/gui 1.28+ and on core/gui 2.x (>=1.70.0,<3.0.0 and >=1.28.0,<3.0.0) for the merge window

0.3.0: control layout on a double tap of the case — pads report as `pad` frames, FL script maps them to transport/pattern/metronome/undo and eight channel mutes lit by the mixer track meter; metronome pad blinks with the beat and runs the tempo at a rate set by where it is pressed, snapping to a multiple of 5 only after a long run (`pan`, core 1.17 onPadPan); host `ping`, 5 s host timeout with hello retry; device->host `mode`
0.2.0: host row (CPU, RAM, clock) and firmware row, fed by crosspad-hil's MIDI hub over companion SysEx
0.1.0: pads to the host, LED/text/beat/transport from it over the DAW SysEx protocol; FL Studio script
